original:
Ensō (円相) is a firmware for the M5Stack Cardputer ADV that generates ambient soundscapes — rain, waves, a campfire, crickets, a singing bowl, and more — entirely from real-time synthesis, with no samples used anywhere. It's meant for meditation, relaxation, or as background sound while you work or sleep.

It exists because a user of C.P.S. had started building something close to this idea and asked whether I'd carry it forward. It's built through conversation with Claude.
